note: Big Horn County has no countywide zoning; its planning page says only airport protection zoning exists. The county GIS MapServer (maps.terragis.net/bighorn) is a terms-acceptance viewer with no REST services found. The Wyoming Interactive Zoning Map service (services6.arcgis.com/CWUB5LdQqLSWLhLO) has no Big Horn parcels. Towns of Greybull and Lovell publish zoning only as PDF maps, and Basin's official map is kept at Town Hall, so no queryable district layer exists.
